g.text: Every website is delivered with fully written HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (where applicable).
Hosting and maintenance with a custom domain are available for an additional monthly fee. Any work
beyond the original agreed scope is not included and will be quoted separately.
Upon full payment, clients receive a license to use, host, and operate their website indefinitely. Clients may
request copies of all project files at any time after full payment. The underlying design, code, and creative
work remain the intellectual property of Bruce Gordon (Designer/Developer) and may not be resold,
redistributed, or repurposed for other projects without written permission.
Completed websites may be featured in my portfolio for promotional purposes, unless otherwise agreed in
writing. Client feedback and testimonials may also be used for marketing purposes, including on my website
